recentItems.title: Son of 9/11 victim traveling across U.S. to display steel beam from World Trade Center's south tower
recentItems.description:

CBS News chief Washington correspondent Major Garrett spoke with Siller about the "Steel Across America" campaign.

recentItems.title: After 9/11 attacks, New York officials said air was safe to breathe, but new documents say otherwise
recentItems.description:
New York City officials have released thousands of unseen documents on the air quality at Ground Zero after the 9/11 attacks. The documents reveal more evidence that concerns about the air persisted for months after the attacks, despite officials assuring the public the area was safe. New York Times reporter Sally Goldenberg joins "The Takeout" to discuss.
